messages:
Ana: Quick design ping
Attached two small variants for the billing surface: Project rollup cards (compact) vs Ledger rows (detailed). Which should be default on login?
Devon: Rollup default for PLG makes sense. Ledger as a second tab or expand. Less API load initially.
Sasha: Agree. Technical note: lazy-load ledger lines on expand (GET /billing/:org/invoice/:id/lines). Cache the rollup with short TTL + ETag.
Matt: Copy: default CTA should read "Save as PDF" not just "Download". Also show "Export CSV" secondary.
Jordan: Accessibility: scope toggle needs aria-label="Switch billing scope" and keyboard focus. Token chips fail contrast at small sizes 6a8 increase weight or use outline.
Ana: UX: show aggregate tokens + small chevron to expand breakdown by denomination; default collapsed. Add a micro-sparkline for trend.
Devon: Mobile: summary first, then "View ledger" opens full-screen drawer. Avoid complex tables.
Matt: Action items: Ana updates mocks, Sasha specs lazy endpoint & ETag, Jordan adds telemetry events, Devon confirms PDF footer behavior.
Ana: I'll drop updated frames by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
